insight.data_quality.complete: Your available financial records provide a solid base for monitoring business health over time.
insight.data_quality.incomplete: Add the missing monthly financial records to improve the confidence of your financial health score.
insight.focus_weakest_component: Focus first on {component}, which is currently your weakest financial area.
insight.monthly_change.improved: Your overall financial score improved by {delta} points compared with {month}, reaching {score}. Keep building on this progress.
insight.monthly_change.declined: Your overall financial score declined by {delta} points compared with {month}, reaching {score}. Review the weakest component and the latest monthly records.
insight.monthly_change.unchanged: Your overall financial score is unchanged from {month} at {score}. Keep monitoring the components for changes.
insight.overall.low: Your overall financial score is {score}. Prioritize the high-priority action first and review the score again after the next month.
insight.overall.stable: Your overall financial score is {score}. Keep monitoring the key components each month to build on this position.
insight.overall.strong: Your overall financial score is {score}. Keep the current routines that are supporting your financial health.
recommendation.cashflow.improve: Review cash inflows and outflows weekly to protect short-term cash flow.
recommendation.compliance.improve: Keep financial records complete and up to date to reduce compliance risk.
recommendation.data_quality.complete: Keep monthly financial records complete so future recommendations remain reliable.
recommendation.data_quality.incomplete: Complete the missing monthly financial inputs before relying on this score for important decisions.
recommendation.default.improve: Review the underlying monthly records and set one measurable improvement action.
recommendation.focus_component_with_scor: Prioritize {component}. {action} Its current component score is {score}.
recommendation.overall.at_risk: Your financial health is At Risk. Address the highest-priority action before taking on new financial commitments.
recommendation.overall.needs_attention: Your financial health Needs Attention. Start with the weakest component and review progress monthly.
recommendation.overall.stable: Your financial health is Stable. Keep monitoring the component scores and address small changes early.
recommendation.overall.strong: Your financial health is Strong. Continue the routines supporting the component scores and review them monthly.
recommendation.overall.unknown: Your current financial health band is {band}. Start with the weakest component and monitor progress monthly.
recommendation.profitability.improve: Review pricing, cost of goods, and operating expenses to improve profitability.
recommendation.repayment.improve: Track upcoming repayment obligations and keep enough cash available before due dates.
recommendation.trend.improve: Compare recent monthly results to spot negative trends before they become harder to correct.
insight.evidence.weakest: {component} is your weakest available component at {score}/100. Review the recorded evidence before choosing an action.
insight.evidence.buffer: Your cash buffer is {buffer} months of average operating expenses. This component uses {months} recorded months; a smaller buffer leaves less room for short-term payments.
insight.evidence.buffer_change: The buffer was {previous} months in {month} and is now {current} months.
insight.evidence.margin: The recorded net margin is {margin}% after cost of goods and operating expenses; the existing business-type benchmarks determine its score.
insight.evidence.dso: Receivables equal approximately {days} days of recorded revenue. This is a monthly estimate, not observed invoice payment timing.
insight.evidence.self_declared: This repayment and collection score uses your self-declared payment behavior, not observed invoice or payment history.
insight.evidence.trend: The trend uses net cash movement across {months} recorded months. It describes the recorded direction without identifying its cause.
insight.evidence.compliance: This component uses your declared NTN and business registration information; it is not independent compliance verification.
insight.evidence.missing: Unavailable components: {components}. Their weights are redistributed across available components; missing information is not scored as zero.
insight.evidence.complete: All five score components are available. Availability does not mean that self-declared information was independently verified.
recommendation.evidence.missing: Complete the evidence for {components}: review payment behavior and registration details, enter revenue and operating expenses where missing, and build at least three recorded months for trend. Missing evidence is not proof of poor business health.
recommendation.evidence.buffer: Your cash buffer is {buffer} months. Review near-term payments, maintain a cash reserve plan, and check discretionary spending before new commitments.
recommendation.evidence.collections: Receivables represent about {days} revenue days. Review outstanding customer balances and agree follow-up dates; this estimate does not identify overdue invoices.
recommendation.evidence.declared_payment: Review whether your self-declared payment behavior is current, then review collection and payment routines. The score does not contain observed payment history.
recommendation.evidence.registration: Review the declared NTN and business registration details and update missing or inaccurate information. This score is not a compliance certificate.
